rootCause: The mobile native time control had a 13.333px computed font, 39px height, and no explicit WebKit value-subcontrol shrink guard. Physical-iPhone review observed right-edge clipping even though desktop automation did not reproduce an outer-box overflow.
change: Bound the time grid and native input to the available logical inline size.
Allow the WebKit date/time value subcontrol to shrink.
Use a 16px font and 44px minimum control height below 900px.
Preserve native picker appearance, time semantics, and event behavior.
physicalIPhoneUrlBlockReason: The requested all-automated-gates condition is not met because two unrelated Node assertions already failing on the exact main base remain unresolved in this independent fix branch.
